name: Drôme
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A French regional (PGI) designation for wines of the Drôme, where Grenache (38%) and Syrah (33%) are planted most. Muscat Blanc, Carignan and Merlot follow far behind.
